research.searchCoverage: Official CodeRabbit REST API authentication, users, roles, and audit-log docs, Coderabbit Inc. US identity, and dated incident search reviewed on 2026-09-13. The January 2025 Kudelski sandbox/RCE disclosure is a historical non-China incident with vendor remediation; no current unresolved platform breach is asserted.

exception.adoption: Historical incidents for non-China companies may proceed when contained and remediated; current unresolved issues remain held.
exception.usefulness: CodeRabbit read operations provide organization user, role, and audit inventory for integration workflows.
exception.incident: January 24 2025 Kudelski Security disclosure: Rubocop ran outside CodeRabbit's sandbox, enabling RCE on production review infrastructure and potential access to API tokens, secrets, and connected repositories.
exception.remediation: CodeRabbit disabled Rubocop within one hour, rotated relevant credentials within three hours, shipped a production sandbox fix within twelve hours, and later published automated sandbox enforcement. Kudelski and CodeRabbit both describe the issue as remediated in January 2025.
exception.residualRisk: Historical sandbox-escape risk on unpatched self-hosted or unreplicated review tooling. Live authentication and current security posture are unverified.

research.searchCoverage: Official CodeRabbit REST API at api.coderabbit.ai, dashboard API-key header x-coderabbitai-api-key, Coderabbit Inc. Delaware/California identity, and dated Kudelski January 2025 incident coverage reviewed on 2026-09-13. Historical non-China incident is recorded; no current unresolved platform breach is asserted.

incidents.affectedProduct: CodeRabbit production review sandbox (Rubocop outside sandbox)
incidents.affectedData: Kudelski reported RCE and potential access to API tokens, secrets, PostgreSQL, and connected repositories; CodeRabbit reported no customer data accessed.
incidents.remediation: Rubocop disabled, credentials rotated, sandbox fix deployed within hours; later automated sandbox enforcement.
incidents.residualRisk: Self-hosted or unreplicated review tooling that did not receive the sandbox fix remains a historical residual.

research.waiverAuthority: User waiver dated 2026-09-13 permits historical non-China incident coverage.

adaptations: Credential-only healthcheck maps to official GET /v1/users with empty query. The native validator probes the same path with limit=1; the healthcheck omits limit so input stays {}.
Native category is dev-tools rather than Developer Tools: CodeRabbit is an AI code-review API, and Rust CATEGORIES has no security bucket for review tooling.

Returns raw CodeRabbit JSON under data. Query names match the official API (seat_filter, role_filter, limit, cursor). Workspace-only org_id and linked filters are omitted because the pinned list_users handler does not send them.
Returns raw CodeRabbit JSON under data. include_permissions and include_user_count are omitted to keep the native query scalar; org_id is optional for workspace-scoped tokens.
roleId is URL-encoded in the path. Upstream wraps the payload as {role, raw}; the native operation returns raw CodeRabbit JSON under data.

Returns raw CodeRabbit JSON under data. Array filters actions and resource_types are omitted because the native query template cannot express comma-joined arrays without unused inputs. Official search maxLength 200 is omitted because strict-generated schemas do not admit maxLength. Official docs mark this endpoint Enterprise/Admin.
GET /v1/organizations. Optional limit and cursor bind to documented query names. Enterprise plan.
GET /v1/organizations/{organization_id}/repositories. organization_id is the CodeRabbit UUID, not the git-provider id.
POST /v1/users/seats using the organization-key action + user_ids format. Workspace members[] format is omitted.
POST /v1/users/roles. role is cr_admin or cr_member. Optional org_id for self-hosted keys.
PATCH /v1/users/seat-assignment-mode. Self-hosted Enterprise only.
POST /v1/roles. Permissions arrays are omitted; duplicate_from copies an existing role.
PATCH /v1/roles/{roleId}. System roles are immutable.
DELETE /v1/roles/{roleId}. Fails when the role is still assigned.
GET /v1/roles/permissions.
GET /v1/learnings. Array filters repository_ids/user_ids/file_paths are omitted.
PATCH /v1/learnings/{learning_id} replacing canonical learning text.
DELETE /v1/learnings/{learning_id}.
GET /v1/metrics/reviews. start_date and end_date are required YYYY-MM-DD query params.
GET /v1/metrics/review-comments. start_date and end_date are required YYYY-MM-DD query params.
GET /v1/security/scans/code. CSV/SARIF download formats are omitted; JSON pagination only.
